title: My Family
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Families differ: a child living with a grandmother, one parent or a guardian draws the people who care for him or her. Never ask who is missing.

skills.key_step: The child names members of the nuclear and extended family and how each is related, using a family tree.

floor.question: Name one member of your family.

representations: two circles: nuclear inside, extended outside

board.do: Write a small family tree: grandparents, parents, children.
Wait for the child to say extended.
Label the two parts of the tree.

misconceptions.ask: Is a grandmother part of the nuclear or the extended family?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the nuclear family in the middle circle (father, mother, children) and the extended family around it. Grandmother may live with you and still be extended.
Trace on a family tree: aunt, then her son, a cousin.

misconceptions.ask: Is your mother's brother your uncle?
misconceptions.repair: Show both sides of a family tree with uncles on each.

misconceptions.ask: Achieng lives with her grandmother. Does she have a family?
misconceptions.repair: Show many family pictures. Say: family is the people God gives to love and care for us.

checks.question: Name a member of the extended family.
